name: @frame12/experiment-terminal-storyboard
description: Isolated proof of concept: terminal storyboard narration + offline FRAME/12 HTML report from a single structured event stream.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:frame12 && node --test tests/storyboard.test.mjs
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/bin/storyboard.js run ../.. --max-commits 40 --report dist/sample-report.html
